description: Where two or more controllers jointly determine purposes and means of processing, no arrangement exists defining their respective responsibilities for GDPR compliance as required by Article 26. This includes failure to transparently communicate the arrangement to data subjects.
applicability: Applicable when multiple entities jointly determine the purposes and means of processing personal data. Requires documented arrangements specifying compliance responsibilities and transparent communication to data subjects.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of partnership agreements, data sharing arrangements, and multi-party processing scenarios. Requires assessment of whether joint determination exists and if responsibilities are documented.
